services.name: Women Helpline 181
services.whatTheyDo: Immediate counselling, police liaison, rescue support and shelter referral for women facing violence or harassment.
services.accessSafely: Call 181 from any phone. You do not have to share your name or location. Ask for a woman counsellor if you prefer.

services.name: Childline 1098
services.whatTheyDo: Emergency rescue, counselling and protection for children in distress, abuse, trafficking or unsafe situations.
services.accessSafely: Call 1098. A bystander can report without giving the child's identity. Stay on the line until they confirm next steps.

services.name: Emergency Response 112
services.whatTheyDo: Police, fire and medical emergency dispatch for immediate danger.
services.accessSafely: Call 112 if you or a child is in immediate danger. Share only what you are comfortable with; they can use your network location if you allow it.

services.name: Women Police Helpline 1091
services.whatTheyDo: Direct line to women police cells for harassment, stalking and domestic violence complaints.
services.accessSafely: Call 1091. You can request a women officer and ask not to visit the station until you feel safe.

services.name: NCW 24x7 Women Helpline
services.whatTheyDo: Legal guidance, complaint registration with NCW and escalation for workplace or public harassment.
services.accessSafely: Call or WhatsApp 7827170170. You can describe the issue without filing an FIR first.

services.name: One Stop Centre — Nagpur
services.whatTheyDo: Medical aid, police facilitation, legal aid, temporary shelter and psycho-social counselling under one roof.
services.accessSafely: Call 181 and ask to be connected to the Nagpur OSC. You may go with a trusted person. Identification is usually needed for shelter stay.

services.name: Child Welfare Committee — Nagpur
services.whatTheyDo: Statutory protection for children in need of care, abuse cases and missing children.
services.accessSafely: Start with 1098. CWC intake can be done by a parent, teacher or concerned citizen. Do not post the child's photo publicly.

services.name: District Legal Services Authority
services.whatTheyDo: Free legal aid, protection orders guidance and court accompaniment for eligible persons.
services.accessSafely: Call 1516 or visit DLSA at the district court. Ask for a woman lawyer if needed. Bring any documents you already have — none are required for the first consult.

services.name: Government Medical College & Hospital
services.whatTheyDo: Emergency medical care, medico-legal examination and referral to One Stop Centre.
services.accessSafely: Go to Emergency. You can request a woman doctor and a support person in the room. Police intimation is required for some medico-legal cases — ask the counsellor first.

services.name: Railway Child Help Desk — Nagpur Jn
services.whatTheyDo: Help for lost, runaway or trafficked children found at the railway station.
services.accessSafely: Approach the Child Help Desk on the main concourse or call 1098. Do not take an unknown child away from the station yourself.

services.name: Community Counselling Desk (Partner NGO)
services.whatTheyDo: Confidential counselling for harassment, stalking and family safety planning.
services.accessSafely: Walk-in or call. First session can be anonymous. They will not contact police unless you ask or a child is at risk.
